theorems.name: Submission.dor_stationary_mean_curvature_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → 0 < n → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (y₀ : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → y₀ ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ r₀ κ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ 0 ≤ κ ∧ closedBall y₀ (3 * r₀) ⊆ U ∧ ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → T.support ⊆ N → R.IsStationaryAlong N → (∃ H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure ∧ (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) ∧ ∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball y₀ (2 * r₀) → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball y₀ r₀, ∀ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ r₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * σ) / σ ^ n) * R.measure (ball z σ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * R.measure (ball z ρ)
